scope: Environment repair and implementation details only; scientific selectors, labels, evaluation, budgets and final-update rule unchanged
FEA_first_attempt: 8-step sanity stopped before step1: packaged OpenMPI has no orted executable. Original failed attempt retained. No production solve launched.
repair: Scoped OMPI_MCA_ess_singleton_isolated=1 for this single MPI rank/OpenMP process. MPI_Init_thread independently returned0, world_size1. One explicit environment-repair attempt in a new directory; no automatic retry loop.
MS_phase_monitor: Every eighth saved phase is excluded from optimizer batches and monitored only; fixed final1800-update checkpoint, no monitor-driven selection. All128 phases used for frozen embedding extraction.
features: base: source-normalized current,current angle,log speed,log radial scale. Graph: original FE-edge message passing, area-weighted latent node mean, then phase mean/std. Each block standardized on fit subset only and divided by square root of block dimension.
inner_CV: Leave-one-MS-source-group-out among63 calibration rows; features and kernel distance scale refit in each fold. No Full evaluation targets are available to the learner.
field_scope: Vector B projected to nodes is an auxiliary MS target, not the canonical mean-square-B Hybrid evaluation and not a Full J target.
torch_runtime: Separate Python3.12 venv, official offline torch2.5.1+cu124 wheels; shared applications unchanged
